title: garuq sinni roocih gibbatu
intro: Inki rooci yallih aqayyaareh uddur soolaah, rammitle garuq luk miracsenta gorrisa. inkih yaaxige num ta goranah iroh gacse, dubuk sarra baxxaaqissam too tah sorkoco baxi gibbatuk sugte. ta mistirih milaagih gabuuk, qibaadah wale wagittaamal qasiir too abaabissok naharal tammulleeh tan. Atu tama muuci Qur'aanak aydaaduk baxissam duuddaa?
clues: Ixxigaa kee miracsenta yallih kiciyyo farmoytal essere .
Anu numma gorrisuh emeetem, farmoytal kaxxa fayxi luk seeca
Anu woo uddur Yallih ikraaro gersi ekraaro luk sugteemih taagah anu yeexxeeh wonnah ufkune.
Tah fanah Anu qaago margaqa—wohuk muxxi, Anu inni goranah fooca fanah xukkuta
inkih yaaxige num tah sorkocobaxi gibbatu kee maabitina kinnim yiysixxige
Anu Qur'aanak elle baxxaqisan innal: 'Usuk foocal wagitak, wadirih gaceeh, kah kinnim inti maleela kaah yemeete''.
